statement: Axeyum decodes, canonically re-encodes, and executes the seventeen-form x86-64 teaching slice, including all six manuscript listings and declared semantic controls.
scope: Seventeen selected form families, twenty-eight manuscript or resolved fixture encodings, six programs, three trap classes, canonical projection, and four declared mutations.
exclusions: Instructions and encodings outside the selected slice
Extended registers and general x86 addressing
Privileged execution, virtual memory, devices, concurrency, and timing

checker.expected_result: x64-execution: PASS: forms=17 encodings=28 traps=3 mutations=4

negative_control.mutates: Use the instruction RIP instead of the following RIP as the short-branch base

limitations: This is finite executable evidence, not a proof over every x86-64 state.
The executor implements only the declared teaching profile.
Cross-machine refinement remains a separate open claim.
